text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... 
Not yet, not yet...!
choice_data_list:
Looking good, just a little more to the 
goal!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No! More! Merely meeting expectations 
will never let me reach Brian!
choice_data_list: いいよ、目標まであとちょっと！
choice_data_list_en: Looking good, just a little more to the goal!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the limits—one step, two steps 
further. 
Only by pushing into that realm will I 
make it!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Trainer. 
May I add two more reps?
choice_data_list: Wait... Even after doing 20 reps already!?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I feel in excellent form today. 
May I have your permission?
choice_data_list: え……もう20本もやったのに！？
choice_data_list_en: Wait... Even though we already did twenty reps?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I shall be off. 
—Hah!
choice_data_list: ……わかった。行ってらっしゃい！
choice_data_list_en: ...All right. Go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her race against Narita Brian seemed to 
have fired her up... 
lately, she had been frequently requesting 
to add more to her training regimen.
choice_data_list: （最近、やる気に満ちてるな！）
（最近、やる気に満ちてるね！）
choice_data_list_en: (She's really been full of motivation lately!)
(She's been so full of motivation lately!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis's morale was soaring. 
While that was naturally a good thing in 
itself—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Perhaps it is time 
to call it a day after all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet, physically, I still feel... Hmm. 
Trainer, might I ask for your judgment?
choice_data_list: Let's definitely call it here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she felt fine, the sheer workload 
was simply too high. Any more would be 
overtraining.
choice_data_list: さすがに、ここまでにしよう……！
choice_data_list_en: We really should stop here...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, you are right. 
Let us call it a day.
choice_data_list: (...Something seems a bit off with her.)
(...Something feels a bit off with her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, she would have 
decided 
to stop on her own. Furthermore, seeing 
how hard 
she had been pushing herself up to now—
choice_data_list: （……なんだか、いつもと様子が違うな）
（……なんだか、いつもと様子が違うかも）
choice_data_list_en: (...Something feels a bit different about her today.)
(...Something seems a bit different about her today.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, she was a rational girl. 
She wasn't being so reckless as to 
collapse after training, 
but even so... the Oka Sho—
choice_data_list: （もしかして……少し“焦ってる”のか？）
（もしかして……少し“焦ってる”？）
choice_data_list_en: (Could it be... is she feeling a bit 'rushed'?)
(Could it be... is she feeling a bit 'rushed'?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given that the Oka Sho takes place in the 
spring 
of the Classic year, many horsegirls enter 
before 
their bodies and minds have fully matured.
choice_data_list: ハイペースになりすぎることがある
choice_data_list_en: Sometimes the pace gets way too fast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, it is the grand stage of a 
Classic race. 
It was only natural that everyone's 
excitement would run high—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result, there are years where it 
turns into an overly fast race. 
Mental inexperience and the sheer pressure 
of the grand stage 
carried the latent risk of making that 
happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, in the past— 
there was even a time when people 
whispered 
that demons dwelt within the Oka Sho.
choice_data_list: At this rate, Phalaeno might also...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that were to happen, 
would she be swallowed up by that 
blistering pace? 
That unease flickered across my mind.
choice_data_list: このままだと、ファレノも……
choice_data_list_en: At this rate, Phalaeno will also...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, on the other hand...
choice_data_list:
You seem more fired up with each passing 
day.

You seem more fired up with each passing 
day.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I had not 
noticed it myself, however...
choice_data_list: 日に日に、気合いが入ってきてるな
日に日に、気合いが入ってきてるね
choice_data_list_en: You're getting more fired up with each passing day.
You're getting more fired up with each passing day.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I made my debut and crossed blades with 
Brian. 
I learned of the scorching heat upon the 
turf, and of my own inexperience.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—I must act now. 
It is as simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having reaffirmed the heights she must 
strive for, 
she was maintaining excellent motivation. 
That was precisely why I didn't want to 
pour cold water on it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I realized I was agonizing over how to 
guide her. 
Yet I couldn't afford to dither—
choice_data_list: （でも、看過していい問題なのか……？）
（でも、看過していい問題なのかな……？）
choice_data_list_en: (Still, is this really an issue we can overlook...?)
(Still, is this really an issue we can overlook...?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me... I was hoping to pay 
a visit 
to the club tomorrow on my day off. Would 
that be all right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course.
Yeah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After approving her request... I wondered 
how 
the club would approach her current 
situation.
choice_data_list: ああ、もちろん
うん、もちろん
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, of course.
Yeah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the club that once supported the frail 
Phalaenopsis 
and helped her reach the point where she 
could run, 
perhaps I could find the right approach to 
take.
choice_data_list: （……何か、参考になることがあるかも）
choice_data_list_en: ï¼â¦â¦Maybe there's something helpful here.ï¼

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I asked one of the employees at 
the club 
what they do whenever they find themselves 
struggling 
with their training approach, but...
choice_data_list: 明日、俺も一緒に行くよ！
明日、私も一緒に行くよ！
choice_data_list_en: I'll come along with you tomorrow too!
I'll come along with you tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Let me think... We don't really 
struggle with our training approach.

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
The club's overarching philosophy is 
firmly set, 
so we only need to focus on working toward 
that.
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
So... listening to everyone at the club, 
understanding the club's philosophy—and 
using that 
for inspiration would be best.
choice_data_list: なるほど……
choice_data_list_en: I see...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good day, everyone. 
It has been quite some time.
choice_data_list:
Thanks for your hard work! Are you making 
snacks?

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Phalaenopsis and Trainer! 
Yep, it's my turn on duty today!
choice_data_list: お疲れ様です！補食、作られてるんですか？
choice_data_list_en: Good work! Are you making refueling snacks?

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Care to try an anpan? 
This one's for girls who prefer it less 
sweet. And this 
one's an 'apple bun' for girls who don't 
like bean paste.
choice_data_list:
...Tailoring the snacks to each individual 
horsegirl?

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Each girl has her own tastes and 
daily condition, 
after all. So we give them plenty of 
options!
choice_data_list: ……ウマ娘それぞれに合わせた補食を？
choice_data_list_en: ...Nutritional snacks tailored to each Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now! Your pace is dropping! 
Don't run so sloppily! Keep it crisp!
choice_data_list: （仕事が丁寧だなぁ……）
choice_data_list_en: (Her work is so meticulous...)

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Okaaaay! ...Guess it's about time to get 
serious. 
Taaahhhhh!
choice_data_list: How do you decide who coaches who?

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Based on each girl's traits, of course! 
Things fluctuate day by day, though, 
so we don't fix who coaches whom 
permanently!
choice_data_list: 担当って、どうやって決めてるんですか？
choice_data_list_en: How do you decide which girl to train?

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Since we're humans and they're horsegirls, 
compatibility matters, 
doesn't it? We make sure to take that into 
account!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
This is our health management app! 
Ever since we adopted it, tracking 
individual data 
has become so much easier... Praise be to 
the app!
choice_data_list: …………なるほど
choice_data_list_en: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Otherwise, we couldn't create 
schedules tailored to each individual 
horsegirl!
choice_data_list: 体調の記録も、個別で管理してるんですね
choice_data_list_en: So you track their health records individually too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought I already knew, but seeing it 
again... 
I was deeply moved by the meticulous care 
they put 
into providing proper support to each 
individual horsegirl.
choice_data_list: （…………みんなが、同じ方向を向いてる）
choice_data_list_en: (......Everyone's looking in the same direction.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's naturally what any mentor ought to 
do. 
Yet continuing to do it with this much 
care and devotion 
is extraordinarily difficult.
choice_data_list: How are you able to manage all this here?

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
That's probably because everyone here 
truly 
shares a single guiding philosophy.
choice_data_list: どうして、ここではそれができてるんです？
choice_data_list_en: How come you're able to do that here?

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Yes—'Be one who dares to challenge.' 
With that etched into our hearts, all of 
us on staff 
strive our hardest each and every day.
choice_data_list: 理念？
choice_data_list_en: A philosophy?

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
To build as many futures as possible 
where they can take on those challenges.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
...This is a world of fierce competition, 
after all. 
Even if they take on the Twinkle Series, 
there's no telling 
if they'll walk away with a happy racing 
career.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if that's the challenge they want 
to take— 
we want to pave the way that takes them 
there.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
And, hopefully... we want the girls whose 
backs 
we pushed to seize glory for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
That is the 'challenge' that we are 
undertaking.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Even if we ever lose our way while 
coaching, 
returning to that philosophy keeps us on 
the right path.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
So we'll keep giving it our all! 
For the sake of each and every horsegirl!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I finally, truly understand 
just how heavy a baton has been passed to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just from Phalaenopsis herself. 
From everyone working at the club, too—
choice_data_list: They've entrusted Phalaeno's future to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once that sank in, it hit me.
choice_data_list: ファレノの未来を、託されたんだ
choice_data_list_en: I've been entrusted with Phalaeno's future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I want to support Phalaenopsis, simply 
respecting her wishes isn't enough.
choice_data_list: 俺がやるべきも、これだ
私がやるべきも、これだ
choice_data_list_en: This is what I should be doing, too.
This is what I need to do, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I must do is pave the way— 
so that she can take on this challenge.
choice_data_list:
And make the decisions for that future 
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? A mock race... I was under the 
impression 
that basic conditioning took priority 
right now?
choice_data_list: その未来のための“判断”を共にすることだ
choice_data_list_en: It means making the “decisions” for that future together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...You seem to have a plan. 
And who are my opponents?
choice_data_list: 必要なレースを組んだから、走ってほしい！
choice_data_list_en: I've set up the races you need, so go out there and run!

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Kept you waiting, Princess Phalaeno. Good 
luck today. 
I plan on enjoying a pleasant 
front-running lead!
choice_data_list: 『桜花賞』を狙う、君の同期たちだよ
『桜花賞』を狙う、貴方の同期たちだよ
choice_data_list_en: They're your peers setting their sights on the Oka Sho.
They're your peers setting their sights on the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Queenly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
My, Phalaeno-san is here too, I see. 
Ufufu. What a delightful lineup.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, quite. Nothing but peers from my 
class who 
are expected to make waves on the Tiara 
route.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Whatever intentions you have, 
I need only defeat them with all my 
might.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Phalaeno & Others
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh... The front-runner 
is setting a blistering pace...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Aha! 
If you can keep up with my lead, 
afternoon tea is on me!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...This spring. I will seize the cherry 
blossoms for the club 
and repay the hopes placed in me. I must 
make it a certainty.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(If so, in a place like this— 
how could I ever afford to hesitate or 
cower?!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Haaaaaaahhhhh!!
choice_data_list:
(...! Just as I thought, she's pushing way 
too hard...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anticipating a blistering pace, I had set 
up 
this mock race... and it played out 
exactly as expected. 
As a result—
choice_data_list: （……！やっぱり、飛ばしすぎてる……！）
choice_data_list_en: (...! I knew it, she's going too fast...!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Ngh! 
Phalaenopsis, you novice.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...May I ask this of you? 
A strategy meeting.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's talk it out!
Yeah, let's talk it out!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First, to sort through the reasons for my 
defeat. 
...The blistering pace in the opening 
drained my stamina.
choice_data_list: ああ、話し合おう！
うん、話し合おう！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's talk it over!
Yeah, let's talk it over!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I failed to maintain my composure against 
the pace stirred up 
by those reckless runners, and was 
swallowed by it. Am I right?
choice_data_list:
That's part of it, but it's not the root 
cause.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
What? Then what is it? 
What flaw of mine caused this defeat?
choice_data_list: そうだけど、それは原因の根幹じゃないよ
choice_data_list_en: That may be true, but that's not the root cause.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: 真の原因は、君の中にある“焦り”だ
真の原因は、貴方の中にある“焦り”だよ
choice_data_list_en: The true cause is the "impatience" inside you.
The true cause is the "impatience" inside you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The impatience that had flickered ever 
since her defeat 
against Narita Brian had finally come to 
the fore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, she has tremendous ability. 
While unconventional, 
she could certainly stay glued to a 
blistering opening pace 
and still pull off a victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, even if she chose to run near the 
front... 
it shouldn't have been out of impatience. 
She needed to keep those restless feelings 
in check, and—
choice_data_list: Run like yourself.
Run like yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis's true strength lies in 
her "spirit of endurance."
choice_data_list: 君らしい走りをしよう
貴方らしい走りをしよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's run a race that's true to you.
Let's run a race that's true to you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: It is frustrating, but... Trainer.
choice_data_list: Understood. That's enough for today, then.
Understood. That's enough for today, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the past, toward the end of training... 
she 
listened to her body and didn't push 
herself too hard.
choice_data_list: わかった。今日はここまでだな
わかった。今日はここまでだね
choice_data_list_en: Understood. That's enough for today.
Understood. That's enough for today, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was proof of her intense sense of 
purpose, 
and her strength to discipline herself.
choice_data_list:
But right now, that isn't showing in your 
races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She could run so well if she kept to her 
own pace, 
yet impatience throws her off.
choice_data_list: でも現状、それがレースに出ていない
choice_data_list_en: Still, as things stand, that isn't showing up in your races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If so, I needed her to reexamine, once 
again, 
what we were truly "challenging."
choice_data_list: What is our ultimate goal?
What is our ultimate goal?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...To make the Club the "most beautiful 
garden."
choice_data_list: 俺たちの最終目標は？
私たちの最終目標は？
choice_data_list_en: What is our ultimate goal?
What's our ultimate goal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our true goal is not the Oka Sho. 
Nor is it the Triple Tiara. 
It is the future beyond them—the 
"prosperity of the Club."
choice_data_list: ああ。なら――その“挑戦”のために走ろう
うん。なら――その“挑戦”のために走ろう
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. In that case—let's run for that "challenge."
Yeah. Then—let's run for the sake of that "challenge."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only by focusing on her great ambition can 
she run 
unswayed by the pace of those around her. 
To that end—
choice_data_list: レース中も、そこを目指して走る必要がある
choice_data_list_en: Even during the race, you need to run with that goal in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was training meant to forge the mental 
fortitude 
for Phalaenopsis to never lose sight of 
her "goal," 
no matter the circumstances.
choice_data_list: 今からトレーニングの一部を精神修行にする
choice_data_list_en: From now on, part of your training will be mental discipline.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...You have decided this must be done, 
even if it 
reduces the time spent on physical 
conditioning?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that's my call. For the sake of your 
challenge.

Yes, that's my call. For the sake of your 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like the members of the Club, I too 
must make decisions 
without fear—decisions leading to a future 
where 
Umamusume can dare to challenge 
themselves.
choice_data_list: ああ、そう判断した。君の挑戦のために
うん、そう判断した。貴方の挑戦のために
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, that was my call. For the sake of your challenge.
Yes, that was my judgment. For the sake of your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: （それが、トレーナーの俺がすべきことだ）
（それが、トレーナーの私がすべきことだ）
choice_data_list_en: (That's what I, as her Trainer, need to do.)
(That's what I, as her Trainer, need to do.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I was immature.
choice_data_list: Phaleno...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In my impatience, I sought only the 
victory before me. 
I lost sight of the greater picture, and 
how I ought to run.
choice_data_list: ファレノ……
choice_data_list_en: Phalaeno...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I thank you for opening my eyes. 
Truly, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
May I ask you to revise 
our training regimen?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Leave it to me!
Yes! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then, I shall be off.
choice_data_list: ああ！任せて！
うん！任せて！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah! Leave it to me!
Yeah! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the watchful eye of a specialist, 
Phalaenopsis undergoes waterfall
